matches.rationale: No finding addresses Equation (3)'s decomposition/concatenation notation issue; findings focus on Eqs (5)-(6), (9)-(13) dimensional mismatches or Appendix G contradictions, none of which target the unimodal/cross-modal decomposition indexing problem described in GT1.

Finding 2 explicitly identifies the sqrt(d) vs sqrt(N_t) scaling inconsistency between the main text and Appendix B, capturing the same core defect (confusion between feature dimensionality and token-length scaling) as GT2, satisfying R2/R3 despite framing it as a text-vs-appendix mismatch rather than a token-length error.

Finding 1 discusses Eq (13) but only raises a matrix-dimension incompatibility issue (shape mismatch in additions), a different specific defect from GT3's concern about inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector, so it does not satisfy R1/R4.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Raises a plausible but distinct dimensional-consistency concern about Eqs (9)/(13) that is not the injected B-zero-vector defect in GT3.
Correctly flags the sqrt(d) vs sqrt(N_t) scaling inconsistency matching GT2's core defect.
Identifies a plausible contradiction between Section 2.2.2's claim and Appendix G, but this is not part of the listed ground-truth defects.
